summary: Lean derives constructive nonrefutation of an underived de re necessary bearer from necessary population, well-founded actual existential support, and necessary-predecessor lifting without any S5 or actual-reflexivity premise. A separate route combines actual reflexivity, no contingent direct supporter of a necessary bearer, and global well-founded union of necessary-to-necessary support edges; no invariance of cross-world direct support is required. Explicit excluded middle converts each nonrefutation into a positive existential theorem. A decomposition shows lifting follows from the no-contingent-ground and one-way no-novel-edge bridges plus selected-world reflexivity, weaker than the prior proposed biconditional invariance. Five zero-axiom finite models distinguish missing necessary population, actual support cycles, rotating necessary-only support, contingent-mediated alternating roots with empty necessary-edge union, and benign world-varying support. Finite controls are interpretations of stipulated primitives, not verification that a metaphysical premise is true. Neither uniqueness, self-explanation, simplicity nor divine attributes follow.
blocker: The soundness of the existential-support primitive, necessary population, well-foundedness, and the no-contingent-ground / edge-inclusion / global-union alternatives is a metaphysical research question. Establishing one independent premise with meaningful configuration eliminations remains open in #495; no unconditional existence theorem is claimed.
